panels.title: QPS — total + per site + per host
panels.description: Total aggregate line always shown. Per-site and per-host breakdowns stack underneath. Use Host and Site filters to narrow down.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  'TOTAL' AS series,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'qtype'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  multiIf(
    hostname LIKE 'got-%', 'Gothenburg',
    hostname LIKE 'sto-%', 'Stockholm',
    'Other'
  ) AS series,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'qtype'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time, series

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  hostname AS series,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'qtype'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: QPS by rcode — total + per rcode
panels.description: Total QPS as a bold line. Per-rcode breakdown underneath. Use the Rcode filter to select specific rcodes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  'TOTAL' AS series,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'rcode'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  multiIf(
    key2 = '0', 'NOERROR',
    key2 = '1', 'FORMERR',
    key2 = '2', 'SERVFAIL',
    key2 = '3', 'NXDOMAIN',
    key2 = '4', 'NOTIMP',
    key2 = '5', 'REFUSED',
    key2 = '7', 'YXRRSET',
    key2 = '9', 'NOTAUTH',
    concat('RCODE', key2)
  ) AS series,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'rcode'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND multiIf(
    key2 = '0', 'NOERROR',
    key2 = '1', 'FORMERR',
    key2 = '2', 'SERVFAIL',
    key2 = '3', 'NXDOMAIN',
    key2 = '4', 'NOTIMP',
    key2 = '5', 'REFUSED',
    key2 = '7', 'YXRRSET',
    key2 = '9', 'NOTAUTH',
    concat('RCODE', key2)
  ) IN ($rcode_filter)
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time, series

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  100.0 * sumIf(value, key2 = '3') / sum(value) AS nxdomain_pct
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'rcode'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
HAVING sum(value) > 0
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  multiIf(
    key2 = '0', 'NOERROR',
    key2 = '1', 'FORMERR',
    key2 = '2', 'SERVFAIL',
    key2 = '3', 'NXDOMAIN',
    key2 = '4', 'NOTIMP',
    key2 = '5', 'REFUSED',
    key2 = '7', 'YXRRSET',
    key2 = '9', 'NOTAUTH',
    concat('RCODE', key2)
  ) AS rcode,
  sum(value) AS total
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'rcode'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY rcode
ORDER BY total DESC

panels.title: SOA QPS per host
panels.description: SOA queries often dominate due to monitoring/polling. Shown separately to avoid drowning other qtypes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  hostname,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'qtype'
  AND key2 = '6'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, hostname
ORDER BY time, hostname

panels.title: Transport breakdown — requires DSC ip_version/transport datasets
panels.description: This panel requires DSC to collect ip_version and transport datasets. Check your dsc.conf on the collector hosts. See panel text for details.

options.content:
### Transport data not yet available

The IPv4/IPv6 and TCP/UDP breakdown requires additional DSC datasets to be enabled on collector hosts. Add these to your `dsc.conf`:

```
dataset ip_version dns All:null Qtype:qtype ip_version:ip_version queries-only;
dataset transport dns All:null Qtype:qtype Transport:transport queries-only;
```

Once data arrives, this section will be replaced with transport breakdown panels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_subnets AS (
  SELECT key2
  FROM dsc.observations
  WHERE dataset = 'client_subnet'
    AND hostname IN ($hostname)
    AND hostname LIKE '$site'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY key2
  ORDER BY sum(value) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time,
  key2 AS subnet,
  sum(value) / 300.0 AS qps
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'client_subnet'
  AND key2 IN (SELECT key2 FROM top_subnets)
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, subnet
ORDER BY time, subnet

SELECT
  key2 AS subnet,
  sum(value) AS queries
FROM dsc.observations
WHERE dataset = 'client_subnet'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND hostname LIKE '$site'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY subnet
ORDER BY queries DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Last data received per host
panels.description: Detects hosts that stopped reporting DSC data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hostname,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen,
  dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), now()) AS age_minutes
FROM dsc.observations
GROUP BY hostname
ORDER BY hostname
